Summary of where things stand. Both the open question about non-Latin titles and the earlier note are recorded.

**Verified with tool evidence in this session**
- I changed only `slugify` in `blog.py` and extended `tests/test_blog.py`. The write results show both files changed.
- `run_tests` exited 0 with 28 passed: the 3 original tests plus 25 new cases covering punctuation (question marks, colons, ampersands, slashes, quotes, straight and unicode apostrophes), padded titles, empty and all-punctuation titles (which return "untitled" rather than an empty slug or an error), and a check that outputs match `[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*`.
- Simple titles such as "Hello World", "My First Post", "Well-known facts" and "Python 3 tips" produce the same slugs as before.

**Not verified**
- The workspace has no post files, so I could not confirm that slugs for your current posts are byte-identical. That success criterion is only shown for the example titles above.
- These inputs now produce different slugs, and I don't know whether any real post uses them: underscores, double spaces, " - ", and accented letters (which fold to ASCII).
- Titles with no ASCII letters or digits (for example Chinese or Cyrillic) now become "untitled", where before they produced non-ASCII URLs that may have worked. The tests do not cover this.
- Several empty or all-punctuation titles would all map to "untitled" and collide.

**What remains for you**
1. Compare old and new slugs for your real post titles and tell me about any that worked before but now differ, so I can narrow the rules.
2. Decide whether "untitled" is an acceptable fallback.
3. Decide whether non-Latin titles should be transliterated, left as they were, or rejected.

diff --git a/blog.py b/blog.py
index d3a7114..560c070 100644
--- a/blog.py
+++ b/blog.py
@@ -1,5 +1,9 @@
 """Build the static blog from markdown posts."""
 import re
+import unicodedata
+
+_APOSTROPHES = re.compile("['`\u2018\u2019\u02bc]")
+_NON_SLUG = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")
 
 
 def read_post(text):
@@ -13,8 +17,12 @@ def read_post(text):
 
 
 def slugify(title):
-    """URL part for a post title."""
-    return title.lower().replace(" ", "-")
+    """URL part for a post title: lowercase letters, digits, single hyphens."""
+    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title.lower())
+    text = "".join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c))
+    text = _APOSTROPHES.sub("", text)
+    slug = _NON_SLUG.sub("-", text).strip("-")
+    return slug or "untitled"
 
 
 def output_path(meta):

index e5719a9..3efc497 100644
--- a/tests/test_blog.py
+++ b/tests/test_blog.py
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
+import pytest
+
 import blog
 
 
@@ -13,3 +15,42 @@ def test_simple_title():
 
 def test_output_path():
     assert blog.output_path({"title": "My First Post"}) == "posts/my-first-post.html"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "title, expected",
+    [
+        ("Hello World", "hello-world"),
+        ("My First Post", "my-first-post"),
+        ("Well-known facts", "well-known-facts"),
+        ("Python 3 tips", "python-3-tips"),
+        ("What is this?", "what-is-this"),
+        ("Notes: part 1", "notes-part-1"),
+        ("Tom & Jerry", "tom-jerry"),
+        ("Read/Write access", "read-write-access"),
+        ('She said "hi"', "she-said-hi"),
+        ("Don't stop", "dont-stop"),
+        ("Don\u2019t stop", "dont-stop"),
+        ("\u2018Quoted\u2019 title", "quoted-title"),
+        ("  Padded  title!  ", "padded-title"),
+        ("a  -  b", "a-b"),
+        ("Caf\u00e9 time", "cafe-time"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_slugify_punctuation(title, expected):
+    assert blog.slugify(title) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("title", ["", "   ", "?!?", "\"'\u2019&/:"])
+def test_slugify_empty_or_all_punctuation(title):
+    assert blog.slugify(title) == "untitled"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "title",
+    ["Hello, World!", "A/B: C & D?", "--x--", "Don\u2019t \"panic\"", "", "!!!"],
+)
+def test_slugify_output_is_valid(title):
+    import re
+
+    assert re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*", blog.slugify(title))
